name: Yamaha DT360 / DT400
engine: 351 or 397 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's big 70s enduros. Two-strokes with Autolube oil injection and a lot of torque.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
